image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), resting on a green leaf. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is uniformly brown with distinct rows of small eyespots (ocelli) featuring white centers and black rings. The body appears slender and hairy, matching the wing coloration. One clubbed antenna is clearly visible.
